brief:
Summer rains descended on Hebron, the Ma'an news agency reported. The precipitation marked an unusual weather event for the season in the southern West Bank city, where summer months typically see little to no rainfall.

Local residents observed the unexpected downpour, which departed from typical meteorological patterns for the region during the warmer months. The extent of rainfall coverage across Hebron and surrounding areas, as well as any effects on daily activities or water resources, remained unclear from initial reports.
title: Summer rains fall on Hebron
